audience: teams that send SMS and OTP messages through Termii

useCases.title: Check the wallet balance
useCases.text: Read the wallet balance and its currency. The call also confirms that the API key works.

useCases.title: Check whether a number is on the DND list
useCases.text: Check if a phone number is on the Do-Not-Disturb list and which network it uses. List the active sender IDs.

useCases.title: Review the delivery status of recent messages
useCases.text: List the last messages sent from the account, with status, recipient and cost. Pass a message id to read one message.

useCases.title: Send an OTP or a transactional SMS
useCases.text: Send the SMS on the dnd channel, which also reaches DND numbers. Use the history tool to check a send with no clear answer.

useCases.title: Send a promotional SMS after a DND check
useCases.text: Check the number on the DND list first. Then send the promotional SMS on the generic channel. DND numbers block generic messages.
